basic_details.job_title: NIT Jamshedpur Project Assistant (Electronics and Communication Engineering) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering at National Institute of Technology Jamshedpur (NIT Jamshedpur) has invited eligible Indian citizens to apply for one temporary Project Assistant post on the DST-sponsored project "Sol Cycle", at a fellowship of Rs. 20,000/- per month + HRA @ 20%. The essential qualification is B. Sc. or a three-year diploma in Engineering & Technology or B. Tech in ECE/EEE/EE/AEIE/EIE, and the upper age limit is 50 years as of the last date of application. Applications go by email to PI Dr. Surajit Kundu and must be received by 23 November 2026; the

how_to_apply: Prepare the application in the prescribed format, which is printed on page 2 of the notice.
Enclose self-attested copies of all supporting documents, a passport photo and the AADHAR card, all combined into a single PDF file.
Email the PDF to PI Dr. Surajit Kundu at [email protected].
Write the email subject as "Application for Project Assistant under DST sponsored project".
Make sure the application is received by 23 November 2026.
For more information, the notice gives the contact number +91-9832271039.
Name, father's/guardian's name, mother's name, gender, address, email ID, phone number and languages known.
Date of birth and age as on the closing date of the advertisement, with age proof attached.
Nationality and category (GEN/SC/ST/OBC), with proof attached.
Educational qualifications from 10th onwards: 10th, 12th or Diploma, BE/B. Tech./B. Sc., and M. Tech./ME/MS, with university/board/college, year of passing, subject, % marks/CGPA and class.
Work experience (if any), M. Tech/ME/MS dissertation title, BE/B. Tech project title and publications (if any), on separate sheets if required.
Name, address and contact details of two referees, a passport photo, and a signed declaration with place and date.
important_instructions: The assignment is purely temporary in nature and co-terminus with the project. The Institute reserves the right to cancel the recruitment without assigning any reason. Candidates selected for the post can register for the Ph.D. program, provided they satisfy the eligibility criteria for the Ph.D. program at NIT Jamshedpur. Ineligible candidates will not be allowed.

content_sections.heading: NIT Jamshedpur Project Assistant at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Sol Cycle: Spearheading a paradigm shift in solar panel recycling incorporating cutting-edge sorting and separation techniques, as well as state-of-the-art recycling methodologies, maximizing the efficiency of panel disassembly and material extraction
Temporary, co-terminus with the project; initial appointment for one year
Upper age limit 50 years as of last date of application
Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering, NIT Jamshedpur

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only eligible Indian citizens may apply. The essential qualification for the Project Assistant post is B. Sc. or a three-year diploma in Engineering & Technology or B. Tech in ECE/EEE/EE/AEIE/EIE. The notice does not print any experience requirement. The desirable qualification is adequate knowledge in IoT, Wireless Sensors, Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS), AI, computer programming, machine handling and Solar PV Panels. The upper age limit is 50 years as of the last date of application. The notice does not list any age relaxation. Candidates should check their eligibility before applying, as ineligible candidates will not be allowed.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship is Rs. 20,000/- per month + HRA @ 20%. The post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. The initial appointment is for one year, which may be extended later or terminated earlier based on performance evaluated periodically by the PI and Co-PIs. The selected candidate must work in the Department of ECE, NIT Jamshedpur as a full-time research fellow. No TA/DA is paid for appearing in the interview and/or joining the position. The terms and conditions follow the guidelines of the funding agency and NIT Jamshedpur.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Jamshedpur Project Assistant
content_sections.text: For more information, the notice gives the contact number +91-9832271039.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview. The interview is tentatively on 25 November 2026 at 11 AM. The notice does not print the interview venue. Original documents of age proof, certificates, degrees, mark sheets and other testimonials must be presented at the time of interview and joining (if selected) for verification. The notice asks candidates to refer to the Institute website for updates, if any.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The assignment is purely temporary in nature and co-terminus with the project. The Institute reserves the right to cancel the recruitment without assigning any reason. Candidates selected for the post can register for the Ph.D. program, provided they satisfy the eligibility criteria for the Ph.D. program at NIT Jamshedpur. Ineligible candidates will not be allowed.
